scope: Root-local M1 scene only; no backend schema or API change

compatibility.initialUpdate: Immediate; asynchronous construction retains latest input pair only
compatibility.selectionOwner: W03 controller; scene only calls injected root-local select callback
compatibility.writes: Scene intents issue zero HTTP writes; never modify snapshot, seatId or task/meeting status
compatibility.unknownWrite: W03 uncertain barrier unchanged; scene retry cannot unlock or replay writes

geometry.roomMapping: Explicit mapping to existing snapshot roomIds; missing/locked rooms cannot admit a move
geometry.navigation: EasyStar four-neighbor, no diagonals, unit cell cost
geometry.assetBaseline: Pending approved VIS references and independently validated runtime atlas; concept boards are not runtime assets

camera.rightTap: Movement <=6 CSS px and released on same target opens local menu; >6 pans with no menu or command
camera.safeRect: Actual drawable viewport excluding visible panels; selected target and marker remain visible when details open
camera.close: Retain selection; restore pre-panel camera when adjustment was required
camera.emptySafeRect: Pause scene interaction, preserve camera, show DOM entry; never divide by zero
camera.dpr: Backing-buffer density only, not a second multiplier for pointer coordinates

reservationRules: Validate shape/entity/map/lock/reachability before replacing old intent
One target reservation owner, one cell owner, no opposite edge swap
Reserve new destination before undocking; release old seat after reaching legal stand point
Arrive at approach before docking to sit; validate reservation ownership again
Selecting same agent and unrelated snapshots never restart/cancel motion
Hidden state pauses foreground clocks; reduced motion still honors path/occupancy legality
motion.source: All movement/activity feedback explicitly demo; no model execution inferred

runtimeAssetChecks: Local allowlisted PNG/atlas; no data-controlled URLs or path construction
Unique frame and anchor IDs; finite coordinates; rectangles inside PNG bounds
Every animation frame resolves and every direction has an identifiable fallback
One declared ground pivot per frame; standing/walking/docking/seated align with chair
Map dimensions and collision matrix agree; all approach points reachable from legal spawns
Exactly 8 work and 6 meeting anchors; doors remain passable; no overlapping footprints
Missing/unknown resources fail safely with DOM access; never accept blank canvas
Record author/source/terms/hash independently; no unreviewed redistribution rights inferred
remainingBeforeFreeze: Independent W00V and technical review, plan approval, BB freeze
Concrete Tiled export mapping, map layout/collision oracle and actual atlas rectangles conforming to draft schemas
Replace design fixtures with actual runtime map/atlas inputs and retain semantic validation evidence
Approve candidate motion timings, navigation budgets, camera and small-screen behavior
Complete first-batch NFR measurement environment; no metrics waived
